output.reason: [ev-c0fcac29e341] says the fix addresses an Envoy memory leak with HTTPS under slow requests or high packet loss. The linked issue [ev-c17e4e5305c5] [ev-5ce91f49f202] says the leak affects Istio 1.19 and later. It names the cause: a change (PR 46227) that set Envoy's listener_filters_timeout to 0s, which turns off the listener-filter timeout timer. That is enough to write applicability: Envoy proxies on 1.19–1.23 that handle HTTPS (TLS) traffic, with a bug-fix consequence and no operator action. Confidence is low because the issue text is cut off before it gives the fix's new timeout value or the exact listeners affected, and the network-condition trigger can only be seen at runtime.
